spec:
Found while designing G1003 (2026-11-01). Bootstrap step 7 says to turn GitHub's "Automatically delete head branches" on, while G1025 (release branching) recommends it off in branching repositories, because deleting a dependency's branch on merge closes or retargets stacked and release PRs. Make the bootstrap skill and REPAIR/MIGRATING say: on without settings.branching, off with it, and why; validate warns when branching is configured and auto-delete is on (if readable).

Acceptance: skill text and a validate warning test (or a documented reason the setting is unreadable); docs/design edits per G1017's rule.
title: Bootstrap's branch-deletion advice must match release branching
